TRIALMON: safety screening snapshot

A read-only snapshot of the console at the Cohort 4 data cut (synthetic data)

Computed from the synthetic CSVs in trialmon_shiny/data/ by R/logic.R. Every level rolls up worst-of, watch included. The interactive version is the Shiny console; the rules are explained in the guide; the committee view is the SRC packet. The screen flags; the medical monitor and the committee decide.

eDISH

Peaks need not be concurrent; the upper-right quadrant is a prompt to check timing. Potential Hy’s Law (RED) requires TBL above 2x ULN on or after an aminotransferase elevation (ALT or AST at least 3x ULN) within 30 days of it; every such draw opens its own window.

Illustrative 3+3 reference: 1 of 3 means expand to 6; 1 of 6 is escalation-eligible; 2 or more means the dose exceeds the MTD. Cohort 4 depends on the pending adjudication of CP101-018. The committee decides.
